args:
set -euo pipefail
SMI=""; DECLARED=0
fail() { DECLARED=1; exit $1; }
R=/mnt/proxy; TAG=pairings-lp-$CFGK-s$SEED-shard${SHARD}of${NSHARDS}-try$EVAL_TRY; D=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
RUN=$RUN_DIR
ROLL=$R/rollouts/pairings/$CFGK-s$SEED
OUT=$ROLL/lp-shard${SHARD}of${NSHARDS}-try$EVAL_TRY.jsonl
LOG=$R/logs/$TAG-$D.log; GPUCSV=$R/logs/$TAG-gpu-$D.csv
mkdir -p $R/logs $ROLL
exec > >(tee -a $LOG) 2>&1
TEE=$!
: > $GPUCSV
phase() { echo "=== PHASE $1 $(date -u +%H:%M:%S)"; echo "#phase $1" >> $GPUCSV; }
finish() {
  rc=$?; set +e
  case $rc in 2|10|13|15|19|21) [ "$DECLARED" = 1 ] || { echo "[exit] code $rc came from a tool, not a decision of this script; reporting 1"; rc=1; } ;; esac
  [ -n "$SMI" ] && { kill $SMI 2>/dev/null; wait $SMI 2>/dev/null; }
  echo "#phase end" >> $GPUCSV
  awk -F', ' 'BEGIN{p="start"} /^#phase/{p=$0; sub(/^#phase /,"",p); next} {v=$2; sub(/ %/,"",v); s[p]+=v; n[p]++; S+=v; N++} END{for(k in n) printf "[gpu-summary] %s: %d samples, mean %.1f%%\n", k, n[k], s[k]/n[k]; if(N) printf "[gpu-summary] all: %d samples, mean %.1f%%\n", N, S/N}' $GPUCSV
  echo "[cgroup] memory.peak $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak 2>/dev/null || echo n/a) bytes, memory.current $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current 2>/dev/null || echo n/a) bytes"
  echo "[cgroup] $(grep -E '^anon ' /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 'anon n/a') (bytes, at exit); $(grep -E '^file ' /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 'file n/a') (page cache)"
  for f in $OUT $OUT.errors.jsonl; do
    if [ -f $f ]; then
      echo "=== FILE $(basename $f) sha256 $(sha256sum < $f | cut -d' ' -f1) bytes $(stat -c %s $f) lines $(wc -l < $f)"
      # the records body (it holds test outcomes) is printed only on exit 0; a failed pod's log shows the header only (PR #48 review S1)
      if [ "$f" = "$OUT.errors.jsonl" ] || [ $rc = 0 ]; then cat $f; else echo "(records body not printed: pod exit $rc; the file is on the PVC at $f)"; fi
      echo "=== END $(basename $f)"
    fi
  done
  if [ -f $OUT.errors.jsonl ]; then echo "[errors] $(basename $OUT).errors.jsonl EXISTS: read it before any outcome"; else echo "[errors] no .errors.jsonl for this shard"; fi
  date -u; echo "=== exit $rc"
  exec 1>&- 2>&-; wait $TEE 2>/dev/null
  exit $rc
}
trap finish EXIT
echo "=== STAGE 2 LIBERO-PLUS EVALUATION (test-set use): config $CONFIG seed $SEED, shard ${SHARD}/${NSHARDS} of the 30,090 rollouts (10,030 episodes x eval seeds 41, 42, 43), checkpoint $RUN/model.pt -> $OUT"; date -u
echo "SRC_GIT_COMMIT=$SRC_GIT_COMMIT SHARD=$SHARD NSHARDS=$NSHARDS EVAL_TRY=$EVAL_TRY ENVS=$ENVS CUDA_GRAPH=$CUDA_GRAPH ROLLOUT_CAP_S=$ROLLOUT_CAP_S"
[[ "$SRC_GIT_COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "ABORT: SRC_GIT_COMMIT is not a 40-hex commit (not filled at submit?)"; fail 10; }
[[ "$EXPECT_MODEL_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || { echo "ABORT: EXPECT_MODEL_SHA is not a sha256 (not rendered from the training log's === MODEL line?)"; fail 13; }
[[ "$SHARD" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$NSHARDS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$SHARD" -lt "$NSHARDS" ]] || { echo "ABORT: SHARD '$SHARD' is not an index of NSHARDS '$NSHARDS'"; exit 1; }
[[ "$SEED" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && -n "$CONFIG" && "$CFGK" = "$(echo "$CONFIG" | tr '+' '-')" ]] || { echo "ABORT: CONFIG '$CONFIG' / CFGK '$CFGK' / SEED '$SEED' not rendered consistently"; fail 10; }
echo "/src = ConfigMap stacking-encoders-pairings-eval-src; checking its 11 keys against the hashes rendered into this manifest (RUN-stage2-eval.md step 4):"
( cd /src && sha256sum -c - <<'EOF'
a097769427138a53828055e888be936545a9feef67e4e488b2fbb4ffceaf7227  rollout.py
6f7ed893bc826ad8d0465ea5f34992d1fb548a5114a00d0f233055795512db6d  lp_eval.py
961945ecaf0be1aa94316a0afa3b7e2d250d33afff00d76dddebfbc6b93b6cfc  proxy_wam.py
61181a74af8825eff0e0b8cb3a220f8483d9f1982642cd90b753cb9e5a87d708  t5_cache.py
7af1f7aa2d595d9e0b7f1fb462f7901c6fa9594d2da7895b0168f0ef3ea2d70d  diagnostics.py
1d7ea029550150e1ed987a9d0bf000bf26e22de022bc2bf6050ff1a68fc86b60  extract_fastwam.py
f334c5604f319f779af6b70d06c0505f2c5df482c4531cb8b779b6894384683a  extract_features.py
81993810937d2692597d1d161e438f7688dc7809d0017628d9603ef1d196e363  fastwam_data.py
880c47cbe741b7fbcd98f44f85e7a1d14747d6c837e0493f4642e5ebbc18ace8  setup_env.sh
bf9651099926914da0e4b32b04d317260a38be8d4b87dcba9813637d1ed91ae3  setup_sim.sh
f3017146fd7e89b79709f5639c003d0688ccafce8257705c566290ccb99b4ef9  env_bundle.sh
EOF
) || { echo "ABORT: a /src key differs from the hash rendered at submit (the ConfigMap changed after the render, or the render did not run)"; fail 19; }
echo "env bundle key: $(cat /src/setup_env.sh /src/setup_sim.sh /src/env_bundle.sh | sha256sum | cut -c1-12) (the prebuilt bundle is 9182f8131559)"
[ -f $RUN/model.pt ] || { echo "ABORT: $RUN/model.pt is missing (did the training Job succeed? is RUN_DIR right?)"; fail 15; }
ls -la $RUN/model.pt
if [ -e $OUT ]; then echo "MODE: resume (records file exists, $(wc -l < $OUT) lines already)"; else echo "MODE: fresh"; fi
EXP=$(( (30090 - SHARD + NSHARDS - 1) / NSHARDS ))   # jobs[SHARD::NSHARDS] of the 30,090
# unique job keys (rollout.py job_key: benchmark, suite, episode_id, eval_seed), so a duplicated line cannot count twice;
# an unreadable line makes the count 0 and the shard runs normally (rollout.py then resumes or refuses the file)
NKEYS=0
if [ -f $OUT ]; then
  NKEYS=$(python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(len({(r["benchmark"], r["suite"], int(r["episode_id"]), int(r["eval_seed"])) for r in (json.loads(x) for x in open(sys.argv[1]) if x.strip())}))' $OUT 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
fi
if [ -f $OUT ] && [ ! -f $OUT.errors.jsonl ] && [ "$NKEYS" -ge "$EXP" ]; then
  echo "COMPLETE: $OUT already holds $NKEYS unique job keys of $EXP; nothing to run (a resubmit after another shard failed)"; exit 0
fi
nvidia-smi || { echo "ABORT: nvidia-smi failed (a faulty GPU node; retryable)"; exit 1; }
nproc; df -h $R /work
phase model-sha
MSHA=$(timeout --kill-after=60 900 sha256sum $RUN/model.pt) || { echo "ABORT: model.pt sha256 failed or timed out (900 s)"; exit 16; }
echo "=== MODEL $MSHA"
[ "${MSHA%% *}" = "$EXPECT_MODEL_SHA" ] || { echo "ABORT: model.pt sha256 ${MSHA%% *} differs from the pinned $EXPECT_MODEL_SHA (the training log's === MODEL line)"; fail 13; }
echo "model.pt sha256 equals the pinned value"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv,noheader -l 30 > >(tee -a $GPUCSV | sed -u 's/^/[gpu] /') &
SMI=$!
gunzip -c /subset/full-subset.json.gz > /work/full-subset.json || { echo "ABORT: gunzip of the subset ConfigMap failed"; fail 21; }
echo "9f4baa42a971bdfad148e19629c08ce74443aa4f2fe0b1512b512ec4649177b2  /work/full-subset.json" | sha256sum -c - || { echo "ABORT: full-subset.json differs from the committed episode list (subset_id 91072e5da8499c99)"; fail 21; }
phase restore
. /src/env_bundle.sh restore    # as the smoke and the proxy's rollout Jobs; sourced, so it cannot be wrapped in `timeout`; a failure exits via set -e
GRAPH=""; [ "$CUDA_GRAPH" = 1 ] && GRAPH="--cuda-graph"
COMMON="--run-dir $RUN --t5 $R/feats/t5 --vae-path $R/models/Wan2.2_VAE.safetensors --tasks $R/lp_tasks.json --subset /work/full-subset.json --eval-seeds 41,42,43 --clean 0 --order-seed 0 $GRAPH --monitor-s 600 --shard $SHARD/$NSHARDS"
phase rollout-envs$ENVS
echo "FLAGS: python /src/rollout.py run $COMMON --envs $ENVS --out $OUT"
T1=$SECONDS; rc=0
timeout --kill-after=60 $ROLLOUT_CAP_S python /src/rollout.py run $COMMON --envs $ENVS --out $OUT 2>&1 | sed "/using task orders/d" || rc=$?
case $rc in
  0) ;;
  2) echo "ABORT: rollout.py exited 2 (argparse: a bad flag, deterministic)"; fail 2 ;;
  124) echo "ABORT: the rollout pass hit its $ROLLOUT_CAP_S s cap (records so far are in the file; a retry resumes)"; exit 16 ;;
  137) if [ $(( SECONDS - T1 )) -ge $ROLLOUT_CAP_S ]; then echo "ABORT: the rollout pass hit its $ROLLOUT_CAP_S s cap (killed after the grace; a retry resumes)"; exit 16; fi; exit 137 ;;
  *) exit $rc ;;
esac
echo "=== done"
containers.name: main
